jobs.description:
Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group.

jobs.occupation: Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent | Customer Support Officer | East-European Languages
jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

What IS cream all about ?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe:

- 1/3 personal development - 1/3 collective intelligence - 1/3 intrapreneurship - bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues

Your future projects :

Like Morgane, Functional Analyst at Cream, you act as a bridge between business and IT teams within the banking sector. You translate business needs into functional specifications for digital platforms such as mobile applications, AI solutions or e-Commerce tools. Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.

Our clients of the energy sector produce and transport electricity and gas for the Belgian market. To support their specific business issues, they develop in-house IT products.

In order to run Energy projects related to smart metering, electrical network stability, customers and contracts management, gas flow management, legal regulations, real time data management, energy management trading, Grid maintenance and development, etc. the Functional Analyst captures, consolidates and communicates the information from the various business stakeholders to the IT teams in order to provide them the necessary pieces of information to create a new solution.
Your tasks will be

• Translating business requirements into a structured IT solution while keeping a functional approach

• Using your energy industry knowledge to help translating this functional design into well-tailored technical design

• Collaborating with the business analysts for proper translation of the needs

• Testing of the product before delivery to the users

• Following up of technical designers and programmers
